task: Fix shared Marketplace assistant link redirect so unauthenticated users land on the originally requested assistant after login, by saving the current URL to sessionStorage before the sign-in redirect and restoring it with open-redirect sanitization after successful login.

key_reasoning.reason: api.ts (handleSessionExpired) and SignInPage.tsx (handleSignIn) are the two primary components changed across HTTP-client and Presentation/Auth layers; api.ts is the central shared HTTP client used throughout the app, which triggered the core-shared-utility red flag bump from M to L.

The fix modifies the auth sign-in flow (session-expiry handling and post-login navigation) and explicitly requires open-redirect sanitization — two red flags applied (auth/authorization and security requirements). The precedents exist in onboardingStore.entryUrl and EPMCDME-12556, so actual implementation risk is contained, but the red-flag rules apply regardless.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M (3) to L (4): api.ts is a core shared utility (central HTTP client for the entire app)
Technical Risk bumped from S (2) to M (3): fix modifies the authentication sign-in flow and session-expiry handler (auth/authorization red flag)
Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): task explicitly requires open-redirect sanitization as a mandatory step (security requirements red flag)
